Available domains associated with SONM either resolve to unrelated services or show expired status, and no independent source confirms an operator by that name maintains a data center presence in Santa Fe. The facility is located in the John F. Simms Building, a former New Mexico state office building, but no published power specifications exist for this site.

New Mexico has fourteen mapped data center facilities on record, but this campus is the only one in the state with any published megawatt capacity figure. That figure is not actually published here; the state total remains zero megawatts of confirmed IT load, making any ranking nominal and this site's significance to grid constraint analysis indeterminate.
